'''Operation: Insignificant''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] coordinated campaign to hit multiple [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Lant Mining Corporation]] across the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. [[Brak Sector Force]]s attacked multiple LMC [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]], [[Mining/Legends|mines]] and distribution centers. Projected repair time for the facilities was estimated at ten to fourteen [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. Several Imperial [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]] were ambushed and destroyed. Most Alliance mission objectives were achieved, although impromptu [[Battle of Lish V|action]] over [[Lish V]] resulted in the loss of half of [[Oracle Squadron/Legends|Oracle Squadron]].<ref name="FBS" />
